scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && node scripts/run-apps.mjs dev
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run dev --workspace @field-atlas/frontend --
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run dev --workspace @field-atlas/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/backend && npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
